examples.en: We need a miracle to win.
The baby is our little miracle.
It was a miracle that the plane landed safely.
examples.ar: إنها كانت معجزة أن الطائرة هبطت بأمان.

examples.en: The story tells of a miracle in the desert.
Finding my keys was a small miracle.
Only a miracle can save the company now.
examples.ar: فقط معجزة يمكن أن تنقذ الشركة الآن.
